title: Order and checkout trust boundary
summary: Defines checkout as a server-owned state transition: authoritative pricing, PaymentIntent verification, guarded paid CAS, order authorization, inventory and refund authority.
notes: Type set by manifest (ADR). Source has no Status field and no Decision/Consequences sections, so locked stays false per the Accepted-only rule; synthesizer may treat as locked if the manifest intends it. Filename suffix is a fallback: no shell available to compute SHA-256 of the path.
